items.statement: uct_ib_iface_dev_addr_is_reachable unpacks the remote device address, validates PKEY compatibility, and dispatches matching Ethernet link layers to the RoCE reachability classifier.
For RoCE peers, the classifier handles wildcard or all mode first, then checks RoCE version and RoCEv2 address family and GID conversion before selecting route or local-subnet evaluation.

Wildcard or all mode returns reachable before route or subnet checks, matching non-v2 peers are assumed reachable, version, family, or GID-conversion mismatches fail, and remaining RoCEv2 peers branch by configured mode.

RoCE interface initialization stores the effective reachability mode and subnet-prefix length; prefix bits are forced to zero outside RoCEv2 local_subnet mode and also fall back to zero when mask discovery fails.
Interface construction acquires GID information, optional completion-channel state, statistics, and TX/RX CQs, while failure labels and cleanup destroy those resources in reverse dependency order.
PKEY mismatch or partial-only membership fails before link-layer classification; only two Ethernet endpoints enter RoCE checks, and local_subnet treats a zero-bit prefix as matching every address.
The local_subnet gtest sends an active message between two endpoints, flushes outstanding work, waits for the receive counter to advance, and verifies the received length and payload.
Missing RoCE netdevs or accepted routes, RoCE version or family mismatches, invalid GIDs, and IB/RoCE link-layer mismatches return unreachable and populate a reason string for the caller.
UCX identifies RoCE by the Ethernet link-layer flag: matching local and remote Ethernet endpoints use RoCE reachability rules, whereas an IB/RoCE link-layer mismatch is unreachable.
items.description: Matching local and remote Ethernet link layers delegate to RoCE reachability checks, while mismatched IB and RoCE link layers are unreachable.

items.statement: During RoCE address-prefix initialization, enabling the legacy rocev2_local_subnet option replaces the configured reachability mode with local_subnet for backward compatibility.
items.description: For backward compatibility, the legacy rocev2_local_subnet setting overrides the configured reachability mode to local_subnet.
